films.canonicalTitle: 2026 Sundance Festival Short Film Tour (Open Captioning)
films.displayTitle: 2026 Sundance Festival Short Film Tour (Open Captioning)
films.descriptionZh: 本单元从本年电影节遴选六部短片，包括若干评审奖得主，呈现多样国际短片样貌。
films.descriptionEn: A curated selection of six standout short films from the festival program, including Jury Award winners, offering a cross‑section of nonfiction and narrative work from around the world compiled into a single tour program.

films.canonicalTitle: 2026 Sundance Film Festival Short Film Tour
films.displayTitle: 2026 Sundance Film Festival Short Film Tour
films.descriptionZh: 从本届圣丹斯影展遴选出的短片合集，呈现多样题材与导演视角。
films.descriptionEn: A curated program of short films drawn from this year’s Sundance Film Festival, gathering diverse voices and genres into a single showcase that highlights contemporary short filmmaking and emerging directors.

films.descriptionZh: 上世纪六十年代的小说家周在写作与情感之间游走，借虚构与现实交织出丰腴的忧郁。
films.descriptionEn: A sort-of sequel revisiting Chow as a suave science-fiction writer in 1960s settings, intercutting his affairs with scenes from his novel set in the year 2046 to craft a film of voluptuous melancholy and memory.

films.descriptionZh: Kubrick 的反乌托邦经典，35mm 放映并由 Rafer Guzmán 引介。
一名卧底警察因涉入危险新藥而逐漸失去自我。
films.descriptionEn: An undercover cop in a near-future world becomes entangled with a dangerous new drug and, as a result of his involvement, begins to lose his own identity.

films.descriptionZh: 孤獨白領保羅在深夜紐約展開一連串荒誕又危險的夜間遭遇。
films.descriptionEn: A Midtown computer jockey ventures into the pre-gentrification downtown night with no money or way home, encountering an escalating parade of eccentric characters in a black comedy of paranoia, class tension, and surreal misadventure.

films.descriptionZh: 一名美军上尉奉命深入越战腹地执行秘密任务，航程逐渐化为疯狂之旅。
由巴巴拉·哈默档案与访谈拼贴而成，呈现她的创作与晚年。
芭比在理想的芭比樂園遭遇存在危機，並引出肯的存在焦慮。
films.descriptionEn: In a perfect, manufactured world, beings live flawless lives—until existential crises (and a Ken) reveal cracks beneath the surface of Barbie Land.

films.descriptionZh: 複雜未來城中，獵人德卡德受命追緝幾名逃回地球的複製人。
films.descriptionEn: In a near future where engineered humans serve as laborers, a retired Blade Runner is tasked with hunting four replicants who have returned to Earth and begun killing; a dark, atmospheric hunt that questions what it means to be human.

films.descriptionZh: 日常将人碾为尘土，梦境成了逃生与疯狂的庇护所。
教授在古老档案中追踪疑似被梵蒂冈掩盖的时间观看装置，走入文字与阴谋的迷宫。
两个失恋警察、菠萝罐头与加州梦交织的香港情书。
生物教授在生物科技大会爆发变异病毒，困在会场与幸存者奋战。
侯孝贤以当代台北为中心，讲述一位年轻女子如何努力稳住濒临崩裂的家庭。
路易丝企图骗取婆婆的遗产，却让家族秘事逐渐演变为一连串谋杀。
洛城高楼遭恐怖分子劫持，一名下班在場的警察孤身反擊，成為唯一希望。
films.descriptionEn: High above Los Angeles, terrorists seize a building and take hostages; an off-duty cop hiding inside becomes the sole hope as he fights alone to survive and stop them.

films.descriptionZh: 三名炸弹少年卷入黑帮与暴力，怒火般的反叛宣泄全片。
格鲁吉亚青年步入酒厂与成人世界的温柔讽刺。
17岁的Isabel在豪华高尔夫度假村当“发球女孩”，暗藏等级与暴力的阴影逐渐浮现。
回溯一起早期饒舌網絡风波，探讨点名文化、性别与同意的影响。
和平之地遭机械军团袭击，人民被石化，众人寻因。
films.descriptionEn: In a distant world, a peace‑loving civilization faces a merciless army of automata that turns its people to stone; a council of matriarchs sends brave seekers to discover the source of the Men of Metal and confront their destiny.

films.descriptionZh: 王家卫以布宜诺斯艾利斯为背景拍一段反复破裂的爱情。
讽刺又辛辣的校园黑色喜剧，毒舌与暗黑笑料交织。
films.descriptionEn: A cynical, surreal dark high‑school comedy that masks sharper themes beneath gleefully nasty putdowns and iconic performances; its bitter humor and memorable lines have made it one of the most influential teen films in modern times.

films.canonicalTitle: How to Divorce During the War
films.displayTitle: How to Divorce During the War
films.descriptionZh: 高飞女高管玛丽娅在俄军入侵前一天提出离婚，夫妻在难民与中年危机中分离。
films.descriptionEn: High-flying executive Marija tells her husband she wants a divorce just one day before a sudden invasion upends everything, forcing their private choice to collide with a national emergency and its chaotic fallout.

films.descriptionZh: 年輕的艾略特成為藝術家兼挑釁者的性靈感與下屬，慾望與權力關係逐漸改變他的生活。
films.descriptionEn: Elliot, an aimless twenty-something, becomes the sexual muse and subordinate to provocative artist Erika Tracy; their charged relationship forces him to confront desire, boundaries, and his existing relationships as power dynamics escalate.

films.descriptionZh: 一名年輕女子從孤立生活走出，與卡車司機與舊愛展開親密相遇。
两个高中闺蜜的关系因其中一人变成吞食男孩肉体的魅魔而破裂，校园惊悚与戏谑并存。
films.descriptionEn: High‑school best friends Anita and Jennifer navigate a fraught dynamic when Jennifer transforms into a succubus with a taste for the flesh of their male classmates, blending camp, kink, and practical gore with sharp screwball momentum.

films.descriptionZh: 巴黎郊区三位青年在骚乱后的一天，怒火不断逼近爆点。
年长诗人被年轻崇拜者重新发现，虚荣与旧梦随之苏醒。
勞倫斯在沙漠中聯合阿拉伯部落，掀起對奧斯曼帝國的戰爭與身世探索。
films.descriptionEn: A sweeping biography traces an enigmatic desert-loving Englishman who unites Arab tribes to fight the Ottoman Turks during World War I, presenting a complex portrait of his character and deeds.

films.descriptionZh: 91岁前演员拒卖老屋，儿孙逼她搬家，陌生男子打破晚餐平静。
films.descriptionEn: A fiercely independent 91-year-old former actress faces pressure from her son and granddaughter to sell the family home, and must prove she can still handle herself when a strange young man crashes their dinner.

films.descriptionZh: 美食网红的成功压力唤醒她极力压下的过往。
films.descriptionEn: A plucky dishwasher at a trendy food content company leaps to viral superstardom, enjoying an adoring husband and devoted best friend, even as mounting pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her past.

films.descriptionZh: 细腻重述玛丽·安托瓦内特的动荡人生。
films.descriptionEn: An intimate, stylized retelling of the turbulent life of Marie Antoinette, tracing her marriage into the indifferent French court and the private dramas that have shaped her reputation across history.

films.descriptionZh: 残酷的科西里克家族掳走主教候选人，玛尔凯塔被夺走，十三世纪波希米亚的信仰冲突与暴力交织成史诗。

films.canonicalTitle: Michael Mann's Manhunter: The Final Cut
films.displayTitle: Michael Mann's Manhunter: The Final Cut
films.descriptionZh: FBI 侧写师追捕连环杀手，冷峻色彩与电子乐塑造现代惊悚。
films.descriptionEn: A retired criminal profiler reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track a serial killer, in a tense, genre-defining thriller restored for its 40th anniversary under the filmmaker’s supervision.

films.descriptionZh: Gregg Araki 以两段破碎记忆直视创伤与自我认知。

films.canonicalTitle: National Theatre Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses
films.displayTitle: National Theatre Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses

films.descriptionZh: 离散兄妹在马赛相逢，笨拙重建家庭与情感。
一名职场小白领因催眠事件“放任自流”，意外被提拔并反讽企业文化。
两位儿时好友在太平洋西北的森林里重聚，静默中流露出中年哀愁和友谊的消逝。
拉斯维加斯的一对恋人在周年纪念日争吵分手，各自踏上一夜浪漫奇遇。
一個破碎家庭與放纵青年文化的暴烈悲剧。
films.descriptionEn: A hurricane-force domestic tragedy that follows a delinquent father returning from prison into a violently dysfunctional household, centering on a self-destructive, punk-obsessed daughter and the destructive forces of youth subculture.

films.descriptionZh: 第比利斯弦樂四重奏到山村排練，日常生活與古典樂在鄉間交織成詩。
以1913年脆弱的民国为背景，三位倔强女性在戏曲、权力与情爱间交织冒险。
films.descriptionEn: Set in fragile Republican-era China, three irrepressible women—a would-be Peking Opera star, a warlord’s daughter, and a jewel-thief courtesan—collide in a fizzing mashup of espionage, screwball romance, slapstick, and costume spectacle.

films.descriptionZh: 歌手温斯洛为被窃的音乐与失去的爱人展开复仇，直指操控一切的制作人斯旺。
films.descriptionEn: Singer-songwriter Winslow Leach pursues revenge after the nefarious music producer Swan steals his songs and his favorite singer, setting the stage for a battle over art, love, and a new rock palace called the Paradise.

films.descriptionZh: 胡洛先生在现代化的巴黎迷失于玻璃方盒與奇巧装置构成的都市风景。

films.canonicalTitle: PRIVATE EVENT TODAY IN THEATER & COMMISSARY
films.displayTitle: PRIVATE EVENT TODAY IN THEATER & COMMISSARY

films.descriptionZh: 一位刚出院的羞怯女子在律师办公室里与雇主发展出虐恋关系。
films.descriptionEn: A timid young woman recently released from a mental hospital takes a job as a secretary to a demanding lawyer; their employer‑employee dynamic evolves into a complex sexual, sadomasochistic relationship that reshapes both of their lives.

films.descriptionZh: 巴黎，丧女父亲与神秘精神科医展开追凶复仇之路，正义与执念模糊。
films.descriptionEn: A grieving father and a mysterious psychiatrist embark on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his daughter is murdered, abducting and interrogating suspects across Paris as the line between justice and obsession begins to blur.

films.descriptionZh: 塔可夫斯基的太空哲思：记忆、愧疚与无法复原的爱。
小偷赴南美叢林與同夥運送硝化甘油，與大自然展開生死角力。
films.descriptionEn: A small‑time crook from Brooklyn joins fellow hard‑luck men in the sweltering South American jungle to haul nitroglycerine, turning a perilous job into a bleak, elemental confrontation between humans and nature.

films.descriptionZh: Talking Heads现场影像，三夜同场录制，影史经典演唱会电影。
films.descriptionEn: A landmark concert film capturing Talking Heads over three nights at Hollywood’s Pantages Theatre, featuring David Byrne and the band in a dynamic live performance.

films.canonicalTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.displayTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.descriptionZh: 一位年轻导演前往拜访退隐的原片女星，兩人陷入充滿慾望與恐懼的血腥世界，面對重生與自我實現的試煉。
films.descriptionEn: A young director aiming to revive a camp slasher franchise visits the original film’s reclusive star; their encounter pulls both women into a surreal, bloody world of desire, fear, and delirium under threat from the menacing Little Death.

films.canonicalTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma - 35MM
films.displayTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma - 35MM
films.descriptionZh: 重启中的虐杀片与两位女性陷入血腥欲望世界。
一个为上司当情人住所的纽约小职员，在孤独与苦乐之间搅拌出酸涩喜剧。
films.descriptionEn: An anxious insurance employee lets his boss use his small Manhattan apartment as a rendezvous spot while he courts an elevator operator, a bittersweet comedy-drama set against boozy office parties and caustic holiday cheer.

films.descriptionZh: 一名监听专家从受托录下的对话中察觉谋杀阴谋，也陷入日益加深的疑惧。
诺兰把超级英雄片升级为关于秩序与混乱的都市犯罪史诗。
films.descriptionEn: Chicago doubles as a glum Gotham where Bruce Wayne’s alter ego confronts an anarchic Clown Prince of Crime, while Commissioner Gordon stands as the voice of law in a city tipping toward Bedlam amid looming architectural oppression.

films.descriptionZh: 一名卧底与警局内的内应互相试图揭露对方。
films.descriptionEn: An undercover cop and a mole within the police force each attempt to identify the other while both infiltrate an Irish gang operating in South Boston.

films.descriptionZh: 影片交错讲述维托·柯里昂的崛起与儿子迈克尔掌权后的家族衰落。
偏远苏格兰岛上，兄妹捕猎海鸟并讲述祖辈故事。
films.descriptionEn: On a remote Scottish isle, siblings Isla and Sandy spend their days hunting seabirds and retelling the stories of their ancestors, living a rugged, insular life shaped by family lore.

films.descriptionZh: 一对中年夫妇邀请楼上年轻夫妇聚会，意外发展改变了当晚。
films.descriptionEn: A middle-aged couple invites the younger, livelier pair upstairs for a get-together that unexpectedly upends both relationships, exposing emotional costs and prompting wincing laughs of recognition.

films.canonicalTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
films.displayTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
films.descriptionZh: 霍比特人弗罗多与山姆深入魔多心脏摧毁戒指，决定人类命运。

films.canonicalTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
films.displayTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
films.descriptionZh: 护戒队成员分道扬镳，各自朝两座巨塔的命运迈进，对抗萨鲁曼与索伦的黑暗势力。
films.descriptionEn: In the second part of the trilogy, members of the Fellowship separate and follow different paths toward two ominous towers—Orthanc in Isengard and Sauron’s Barad-dûr—as their intertwined destinies draw them deeper into war and darkness.

films.canonicalTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.displayTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.descriptionZh: 夜晚的京都奇遇记，少女在纵情狂欢中与形形色色人物相遇，展开荒诞一夜。
一名郊区主妇突然离家，独自驾车横越美国寻找生活的另一种可能。
黑泽清的新作，以武士时代故事拆解忠诚与囚禁。
自由奔放的温蒂在与年长离异的杰克的关系中陷入抉择，旧爱回归让局势复杂化。
films.descriptionEn: Free-spirited Wendy finds herself at a crossroads in her relationship with an older divorced father, forcing both of them to confront change and where they go from here.

films.descriptionZh: 两位错误归属的黑帮女友因身份被认错而引发混乱。
films.descriptionEn: Two codependent best friends, scraping by and passing the time bong to bong, are swept into chaos after a case of mistaken identity upends their lives, fueling a rambunctious stoner comedy about friendship and mayhem.

films.canonicalTitle: There Once Was a Singing Blackbird
films.displayTitle: There Once Was a Singing Blackbird
films.descriptionZh: 一位忙碌鼓手在琐事与偶遇中度过看似寻常的一天。
帕里斯劫走海伦，引发万舰奔袭与英雄对决。
一位纽约钻石商沉迷赌局，命悬一线。
年轻人回到家乡，在家庭与阶层现实中重新定位自己。
兩兄弟在俄亥俄農村接受法院指定的戒毒方案，各自面對復原與家庭壓力。
films.descriptionEn: Brothers Cody and Jack Parsons navigate court-mandated drug rehabilitation in a rural Ohio community hard hit by the opioid crisis, testing their bond and prospects for recovery.

films.descriptionZh: 希区柯克关于欲望、替身与执念的迷离悬疑经典。
films.descriptionEn: An ex‑cop turned private investigator tails a mysterious woman and becomes entrapped in a whirlpool of obsession, doppelgängers, and escalating supernatural quandaries that lead toward a tragic denouement.

films.canonicalTitle: Viva Las Vegas - 35MM + Learning from Learning from Las Vegas
films.displayTitle: Viva Las Vegas - 35MM + Learning from Learning from Las Vegas

films.descriptionZh: 一位乡镇教师赴城途中误入酒馆，堕入荒诞与堕落之中。
改編羅密歐與茱麗葉，在紐約幫派鬥爭中上演經典愛情與舞蹈對抗。
关于纽约明星猫头鹰 Flaco 与城市投射的纪录片。
films.descriptionEn: A portrait connected to wildlife rehabilitation that brings educator and rehabilitator Suzanne Highland together with notable avian subject Flaco the Owl, exploring human–wildlife relationships through encounters and care.

films.descriptionZh: 三位旧同学在团聚后逃离家庭日常，重返奥斯陆街头与桑拿，畅谈欲望与遗憾。

films.canonicalTitle: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
films.displayTitle: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
films.descriptionZh: 女配音員佩帕被情人拋棄，引發一連串誇張失控的情感與喜劇事件。
films.descriptionEn: Voice actress Pepa, abandoned by her lover, resolves to kill herself with gazpacho laced with sleeping pills—an act that kicks off a gaudy, cheeky screwball melodrama of unhinged behavior, emotional excess, and tangled relationships.
